name: ui-tick
prompt: Short soft wooden tick of a small boutique counter button being pressed, dry and quiet, no reverb.

name: item-pickup
prompt: Light ceramic trinket being lifted off a wooden shelf, gentle clink with a faint scrape.

name: item-putback
prompt: Small glass object set back down softly on a wooden shelf, single muted tap.

name: shelf-thud
prompt: Solid wooden thud of a small box placed firmly onto a boutique shelf, warm low knock.

name: move-denied
prompt: Dull double knock of knuckles on a hollow wooden crate, disapproving and flat.

name: parcel-drop
prompt: Small paper parcel landing on a shop counter, soft cardboard tap with a paper rustle.

name: triple-chime
prompt: Bright three-note glass chime arpeggio rising, as three matching trinkets sparkle away.

name: order-bell
prompt: Cheerful brass counter service bell rung twice, clear ringing ding with short sustain.

name: round-fanfare
prompt: Warm triumphant boutique jingle, rising bell arpeggio ending with a soft wooden clap and shimmer.

name: round-deflate
prompt: Gentle comedic descending slide whistle falling in pitch, a soft sad deflating tone.

name: undo-swoosh
prompt: Quick reverse whoosh of a small object sliding back along a wooden shelf, airy and short.

name: hint-sparkle
prompt: Delicate magical sparkle shimmer of tiny twinkling bells, light and curious.

name: star-glint
prompt: Single bright crystalline ping of a star gem glinting, high clear bell with fast decay.
